caption.text:
New season, new routine, and a new pair of glasses for every version of yourself. @thejennaway gets it.⁣
⁣
🚐 Campervan: East with Transitions® Drivewear® lenses⁣
🍷 Date night: Gucci cat-eye with polarised lenses⁣
📱 Content creator: Marine with blue light lenses⁣
☀️ Sun-seeking: Ray-Ban Phantos with polarised lenses⁣
👶🏼 Newborn WFH mum: Alora with blue light lenses⁣
💻 Software engineer: Radley with KODAK UVBlue lenses⁣
⁣
One person, six personas, zero reason to stick to one pair. Frames from £39.⁣
⁣
How many versions of yourself are you juggling this season? 👀⁣
#NewSeason #Eyewear #GlassesDirect

caption.text:
🍂 GIVEAWAY 🍂⁣
⁣
To celebrate the start of autumn, we’re giving three lucky winners the chance to win a pair of frames and lenses worth up to £250!⁣⁣
⁣⁣
How to enter:⁣⁣
🔥 Like this post⁣⁣
✅ Follow @glasses_direct⁣
👯 Tag a friend in the comments and include the 🍂 emoji, each comment counts as an additional entry!⁣⁣
☝️ Bonus: Comment on any two @glasses_direct posts published in September for extra chances to win!⁣⁣
⁣⁣
No purchase is necessary to enter or win. The giveaway starts on 15/09/2026 and closes on 30/09/2026 at 11:59pm BST. Open to UK residents aged 18 or over.⁣⁣
⁣⁣
Three winners will be selected at random by @glasses_direct and notified via Instagram Direct Message. Each winner will receive a pair of frames and lenses worth up to £250. Winners will only be contacted via DM from @glasses_direct, with full details on how to redeem their prize.⁣⁣
⁣⁣
This giveaway is in no way sponsored, endorsed, administered by or associated with Meta.⁣⁣
⁣⁣

posts.caption:
🍂 GIVEAWAY 🍂⁣
⁣
To celebrate the start of autumn, we’re giving three lucky winners the chance to win a pair of frames and lenses worth up to £250!⁣⁣
⁣⁣
How to enter:⁣⁣
🔥 Like this post⁣⁣
✅ Follow @glasses_direct⁣
👯 Tag a friend in the comments and include the 🍂 emoji, each comment counts as an additional entry!⁣⁣
☝️ Bonus: Comment on any two @glasses_direct posts published in September for extra chances to win!⁣⁣
⁣⁣
No purchase is necessary to enter or win. The giveaway starts on 15/09/2026 and closes on 30/09/2026 at 11:59pm BST. Open to UK residents aged 18 or over.⁣⁣
⁣⁣
Three winners will be selected at random by @glasses_direct and notified via Instagram Direct Message. Each winner will receive a pair of frames and lenses worth up to £250. Winners will only be contacted via DM from @glasses_direct, with full details on how to redeem their prize.⁣⁣
⁣⁣
This giveaway is in no way sponsored, endorsed, administered by or associated with Meta.⁣⁣
⁣⁣
#GlassesDirect #Glasses #AutumnGiveaway
